incoming.name: Sequoia
incoming.excerpt: The largest populations are in Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park ( Del Norte County), Redwood National Park and Humboldt Redwoods State Park ( Humboldt County).

outgoing.name: Dam
outgoing.excerpt: Kayakers and canoeists frequently travel the Smith River, which is the longest undammed river remaining in California.

outgoing.name: Fishing
outgoing.excerpt: Fishing for salmon and steelhead, (a highly prized rainbow trout over 16 inches (40 cm) long), is best in the Smith and Klamath rivers.

outgoing.name: President of the United States
outgoing.excerpt: After intense lobbying of Congress, the bill creating Redwood National Park was signed by President Lyndon Johnson on 2 October 1968.

outgoing.name: United Nations
outgoing.excerpt: The United Nations designated Redwood National and State Parks a World Heritage Site on 5 September 1980.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: The Redwood National and State Parks (RNSP) are located in the United States, along the Pacific Ocean coast of northern California.
